newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTE WINS FIM 45 MLN CANADA ORDER.
newsitem.headline: RAUTE WINS FIM 45 MLN CANADA ORDER.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Raute Oy's forest industry machine maker Raute Wood unit won a 45 million markka order for a laminated veneer lumber production line from Canadian Evans Forest Products Ltd, Raute said in a statement on Tuesday.
The production line would have an annual capacity of about 40,000 cubic metres, Raute said.
The equipment delivery is a joint project of Raute Wood's production plants in Finland, Canada and the United States, and it would take place in 1997, it said.
